shared_dimensions.pixel_scale: 用户已明确选细粒度：正式地形原生32px/32wu，世界表现统一1wu采样和nearest；从高分母版提取细源，不能把旧16px放大当细源。角色、建筑、装饰及前后景按同一1wu屏幕采样；字体/HUD保持清晰。历史实验不追改。
shared_dimensions.adjacency_and_boundary: 继承同一47-mask邻接语义、核心TileMap与非整格exact-boundary adapter，保留solid/one-way/moving和危险语义；不为图改变碰撞，也不把精确边界冒称全网格。
shared_dimensions.lighting_outline_material: 保留Underworld家族角色、材质与轮廓语言，在统一1wu网格下采用克制暖点光、冷灰空气透视；各层用明度/饱和度/轮廓/细节和视差区分。不能靠细碎噪声与满屏装饰代替构图。
shared_dimensions.regional_variation: 森林差异来自树皮、苔藓、荆棘、有机根枝结构与区域色域；制作与正式平原同族的新材料/边界矩阵，不把平原岩石换色冒称森林。

historical_boundary: 旧提案或失败实现不自动约束新区域；这不等于抛弃正式平原仍在实际使用的Underworld tileset家族。保留原许可/来源、正式消费者和已有效的公共接口。

runtime_reference.player_dependency_boundary: UnderworldPlayer.gd BUILD_PATH/RUN_SHEET/STATES_SHEET directly read animation_build.json and the two body atlases. Bind their complete bytes as well as the script; this is an explicit actual-consumer closure, not a recursive asset scanner. Latest user adoption uses PlayerPresentationRuntime factory for real Home/Plains/Forest bodies, AvatarPresentation session selection and exact candidate motion resources above; UnderworldPlayer remains actual superclass and classic body. Motion/weapon feedback are presentation-only; audio lifecycle is separately tested. No development panels, ability grants or training targets are installed in the formal factory.

validation: Supplement or any shared reference SHA drift blocks new calls and resumes; versioned impact analysis/rebind and fresh affected technical/visual evidence required. Original Bible bytes and old receipts remain unchanged. Cross-region actual golden comparison is required before expanding new regional materials; metadata and hashes never sign visual acceptance.
